messages.cli.scripture.lint.summary: Check every line of scripture (the temple's and each character's) against the grammar and the rules of a lesson: one sentence, visible characters only, no URL or absolute path, a scope the kingdom knows, a fail_kind. Exits 1 on an error. Reads the kingdom only, spends no mana.
messages.cli.scripture.list.summary: List the lessons of scripture with their ref, scope, fail_kind and source; with --character, which lines that character's heaviest session loads and which the 40-line cap leaves out. Spends no mana.
messages.cli.scripture.option.character: The character to show: its own scripture, then the temple's, in load order.
messages.cli.scripture.option.quest: Show the lessons recorded for each session of this quest; cannot be combined with --character. Example: elvaria scripture list --quest q_20261106_7k3m2a prints a heading such as «Session s1 · attempt 1 · assignee · thorn · 2026-11-19T10:00:00+07:00», then «L_20261119_4k2pqz: Run checks before submitting.». Refs come from load_trace.lessons; sentences come from the current scripture, and deleted lines retain their refs. Empty histories and sessions with no recorded lessons have separate messages; a missing quest exits 1.
messages.cli.scripture.quest.journal_error: Cannot read the session history of quest {id}: its journal contains invalid lines.
messages.cli.scripture.quest.current_text: Loaded refs come from the session history; sentences show the current scripture.
messages.cli.scripture.quest.missing_text: text no longer available in the current scripture
messages.cli.scripture.deleted: {file}: ledger entry {lesson} (added {added_at}): you deleted its line. No error; the ledger keeps what the Monk wrote.
messages.cli.scripture.issue.bad_id: the id "{value}" is not of the form [L_yyyymmdd_xxxxxx]; the line never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.bad_head: the scope head cannot be read at "{key}{value}" (key=value pairs in braces, values split by commas, each key once); the line never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.unknown_key: unknown scope key "{key}" (role, class, tribe, os, territory, tag, fail_kind, cli); the line never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.unknown_value: {key}={value} names nothing this kingdom knows; the line never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.hidden_char: the line holds a hidden or bidirectional character; it never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.too_long: the sentence is longer than 300 characters
messages.cli.scripture.issue.html: the sentence holds an HTML tag or comment
messages.cli.scripture.issue.absolute_path: the sentence holds an absolute path
messages.cli.scripture.issue.secret: the sentence matches a secret pattern of the event log; the line never loads
messages.cli.scripture.issue.missing_fail_kind: no fail_kind: the metrics cannot tell whether the lesson helps
messages.cli.scripture.issue.install: mentions installing a package; check it is meant
messages.cli.scripture.issue.env: mentions an environment variable; check it is meant
messages.cli.scripture.issue.cli_config: mentions a CLI's configuration; check it is meant
messages.cli.scripture.issue.network: mentions a network address; check it is meant
messages.cli.scripture.issue.stray: text that is no lesson never loads (a lesson is a line that starts with "- ")
messages.cli.scripture.issue.over_cap: {character}: its heaviest session ({role} in {territory}) has {lines} lessons; only the first {max} load
messages.cli.scripture.none: No scripture yet: no temple/scripture.md and no characters/<id>/scripture.md.
messages.cli.scripture.list.session: {character}'s heaviest session: {role} in {territory}, a quest with every tag: {loaded} of the {lines} lessons in scope load (cap {max}).
messages.cli.scripture.list.no_territory: The kingdom has no territory yet: no session of {character} loads anything.
